prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Pasadena, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1034; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim number.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Pasadena, Texas. I was backing out of a space near the main entrance.

Q: What time of day was it, roughly?

A: It was late afternoon, maybe around five o'clock. It was still light out and the lot was fairly busy.

Q: Walk me through what happened as you were backing up.

A: I checked my mirrors and didn't see anything. I started backing slowly and then I felt an impact on the rear passenger side. A silver SUV had come down the lane behind me and didn't stop in time.

Q: Did you or the other driver brake before the impact?

A: I had already stopped when I felt the bump. I don't think the other driver braked much at all, but I can't say for certain how fast they were going.

Q: Did you get out and speak with the other driver?

A: Yes, briefly. They said they were looking at their phone and didn't see my car. We exchanged insurance information and that was about it.

Q: Did you feel any injuries right away?

A: Not at first. Later that evening my neck was stiff and I had a dull headache. By the next morning the pain had spread into my upper back and I could barely turn my head to the left.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I saw a doctor and they diagnosed whiplash. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week and I'm still taking medication for the pain.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've been missing work because of the pain, and I'd like the claim handled as quickly as possible.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
